messages.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Dear colleagues at Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH,

Thank you for your quote and for explaining your position.

Your on-time delivery over the last four quarters was 88.0% (sc:70710@2026Q3).

We have analysed the cost situation of this part carefully; the options below reflect that analysis.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 4.63 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.
Option B: EUR 4.57 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.
Option C: EUR 4.58 per unit, payment 45 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part - material, conversion, overhead?

We look forward to your view on these options.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Thank you for your detailed response; our colleagues will address your request for a cost breakdown separately. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

We cannot offer a fixed price over a 24-month period due to raw material volatility, but we can agree to this extended term if we implement an AS-14404 index clause. On this basis, and keeping your preferred 30-day payment terms, we can offer a revised price of €5.51 per unit. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.51 per unit.

Our current offer stands at a price of €5.46 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Furthermore, an alternative option is a price of €5.51 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
